title: kb-worker names the open choices that need a gate and lists every consumer of a changed function before it changes it
goal: kb-worker.md tells a worker that a default, a width, an opt-in, a limit or a price it picks is a choice the goal leaves open (a provisional gate), and that a change to what a function returns or takes runs backlog.py referrers on it and covers every consumer in the same item; SP-2vhfsn4o: the orchestrator recorded three ungated choices (ST-vua43tob opt-in, ST-fuflyzxc pack width, BG-jj2nc5ou output count), and two consumers were missed and filed as bugs (BG-3h4g5jdc after ST-x333wyrc, BG-ovvvqtxf after BG-jj2nc5ou)
